title: Horizontal smart truncation total equals a decalage step
statement: Let C be Grothendieck abelian and J a first-quadrant integer bicomplex [def-sp-double-complex-total]. Let L be a filtration of Tot(J) whose degreewise steps equal the second filtration. For every integer q, the totalized horizontal smart truncation inclusion factors uniquely through Dec(L)^(-q), and the factor is an isomorphism. Its inclusion equation determines it, and it is natural in bicomplex maps and all filtered lifts of their specified total maps. Negative q and negative total degrees are included.

source.document: Stacks Project, Homological Algebra and Derived Categories

proof.text: Every diagonal summand of the upper smart truncation has horizontal degree at most q, so its image lies in the shifted second-filtration step. Assemble these restrictions by totalDesc. The proved decalage universal property yields the unique complex factor.

Use totalDesc to construct each diagonal projection. First-quadrant vanishing gives a finite identity decomposition over [0,n]. Projections with horizontal index greater than q annihilate the shifted filtration step. The projection of the total differential to horizontal degree q+1 is the horizontal differential of the degree-q projection: check this on the finite image-supremum generators, where the signed vertical term vanishes.

Project the decalage inclusion into every diagonal term. Past q these maps are zero. At q the preceding differential calculation and the next-degree support condition make the horizontal differential zero; preservation of the cycles kernel by evaluation gives a lift to the smart truncation. Below q use the canonical coordinate isomorphism. Sum the finitely many lifts.

Coproducts in a Grothendieck abelian category preserve monomorphisms, so the totalized truncation inclusion is monic. The summed lift composes with it to the decalage inclusion by the diagonal identity. Cancel this mono to prove the chain-map equation. Cancel the two inclusions to prove the two inverse identities. The inclusion equations also prove naturality for every specified filtered lift.

theorem totalTruncLEToDecalage_isIso
    (J : HomologicalComplex₂ C (.up ℤ) (.up ℤ))
    (hJ : ∀ i j : ℤ, i < 0 ∨ j < 0 → IsZero ((J.X i).X j))
    (L : DecreasingFiltration (J.total (.up ℤ)))
    (hL : ∀ p n : ℤ, L.complexStep p n = (J.secondFiltration n).step p)
    (q : ℤ) : IsIso (J.totalTruncLEToDecalage hJ L hL q)
